description: The password reset request succeeds but no email is delivered.

description: Opening the dashboard causes the application to crash for authenticated users.

description: The profile image appears stretched on smaller mobile screens.

description: Submitting a valid test suite creation request returns HTTP 500.

description: Refreshing after submitting a test case creates a duplicate record.

description: A standard user can access an administrator-only endpoint.
